title: Design System: Guild of Second Chances

display.purpose: Gold amounts, story titles, ceremonial headers — Cinzel at its largest. One per viewport.

headline.purpose: Section titles, modal headers, prestige amounts.

title.purpose: Row names, item names, panel section headers — the smallest Cinzel step.

body.purpose: Default text — descriptions, story text, stats, item details. Source Sans 3 at 0.85rem.

label.purpose: Tab labels, attribute abbreviations, stat labels, metadata.

small.purpose: Subtitles, secondary descriptions, progress times, log content.

shadows.name: modal
shadows.purpose: Deep atmospheric shadow for modals and dialogs.

shadows.name: toast
shadows.purpose: Floating notification toasts above the tab bar.

shadows.name: tab-bar
shadows.purpose: Fixed bottom tab bar separation from scroll content.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default easing for all authored motion. Elements decelerate to a stop — smooth arrival, no bounce.

motion.name: ease-in
motion.purpose: Recovery phase of battle lunge. Slow start, fast finish — reads as pulling back from a strike.

motion.name: ease-out-cubic
motion.purpose: Battle lunge approach. Cubic deceleration makes the fighter's advance feel committed.

motion.name: ease-in-cubic
motion.purpose: Battle recover return. Slow start accelerating to snap back to position.

motion.name: ease-expressive
motion.purpose: Spring-like overshoot for celebratory pops (ascension icon pop-in). The system's only overshoot easing.

motion.name: ease-linear
motion.purpose: Progress bar width. Linear reads as mechanical/precise, not subjective.

motion.name: tier-instant
motion.purpose: Press feedback, scale transforms. Input acknowledgment must feel simultaneous.

motion.name: tier-fast
motion.purpose: Hover, focus, toggle, border/color shifts. Smooth arrival, no waiting.

motion.name: tier-standard
motion.purpose: Sheet slide-up, toast enter/exit, button transitions.

motion.name: tier-slow
motion.purpose: Ceremonial animations: click-pop float, ascension glow/sparkles, story ceremony.

motion.name: keyframe-click-pop
motion.purpose: Floating '+N' on odd-job clicks. Rises 42px, scales 0.8→1.1→1, fades out.

motion.name: keyframe-sheet-rise
motion.purpose: Mobile modal docks from bottom. Short translateY(12px)→none.

motion.name: keyframe-toast-in
motion.purpose: Toast slides up from below and fades in.

motion.name: keyframe-toast-out
motion.purpose: Toast slides down and fades out on dismiss.

motion.name: keyframe-ascend-glow-pulse
motion.purpose: Ascension radial glow sphere — scales 0.7→1.5, opacity 0.9→0.15. Reads as breathing.

motion.name: keyframe-ascend-glow-fadeout
motion.purpose: Ascension second glow layer — from 1.3→0.6 scale. Marks the transition moment.

motion.name: keyframe-ascend-pop
motion.purpose: Ascension item icon pop-in — 0→1.15→1. System's only overshoot.

motion.name: keyframe-ascend-sparkle
motion.purpose: Ascension sparkle particles — 6 sparkles on staggered 0.18s delays, rising 70px.

motion.name: battle-lunge
motion.purpose: Fighter slides toward target. Cubic deceleration for committed feel.

motion.name: battle-impact
motion.purpose: White flash overlay on defender, damage number appears. Flash fades in first 60ms.

motion.name: battle-recover
motion.purpose: Attacker returns to base position. Slow start, fast finish.

motion.name: battle-float
motion.purpose: Damage numbers rise 30px and fade. Normal (gold 16px), crit (red 22px with !), block (ice-blue 13px), DoT (orange 14px).

motion.name: battle-particle
motion.purpose: 8 particles burst on defeat. Random velocity, gravity 0.05px/ms², fade.

motion.name: battle-shake
motion.purpose: Screen shake on impact. Random offset, decays linearly. Crits shake harder.

motion.name: reduced-motion-fallback
motion.purpose: Reduced-motion fallback for toasts. All keyframe animations killed; opacity transition only.

motion.name: charter-fast
motion.purpose: Charter amplification layer — smooth deceleration for shell controls, rows, and subtabs.

motion.name: seal-strike
motion.purpose: Charter earned feedback — pressure ring + rising amount on the Odd Jobs click. Exponential ease-out, never loops.

breakpoints.name: mobile-narrow
breakpoints.purpose: Below this: attribute grid condenses to 3-column.

breakpoints.name: mobile-wide
breakpoints.purpose: Below this: equipment grid condenses to 2-column, skill tree to 1-column.

breakpoints.name: tablet
breakpoints.purpose: Below this: modals dock to bottom sheet.

breakpoints.name: container
breakpoints.purpose: Max-width of .game container; content centered beyond this.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action a screen is actually for — filled gold gradient, ceremonial weight.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid #a98f3a; border-radius: 8px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #4a3d16, #332a0f); color: #ffd75e; font: inherit; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: background 0.12s, border-color 0.12s, transform 0.06s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { border-color: #ffd75e; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { color: #7d765f; background: transparent; border: 1px dashed #3a3324; cursor: default; }

components.name: Default Button
components.description: Secondary action — panel-hover surface, brass border, full touch target.
components.css: .ds-btn-default { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid #3a3324; border-radius: 8px; background: #2b2519; color: #ece7db; font: inherit; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: background 0.12s, border-color 0.12s, transform 0.06s; } .ds-btn-default:hover { border-color: #a98f3a; } .ds-btn-default:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-default:disabled { color: #7d765f; background: transparent; border: 1px dashed #3a3324; cursor: default; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive action — transparent with red border, intensifies on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid #703038; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: #ff8b7a; font: inherit; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: background 0.12s, border-color 0.12s, transform 0.06s; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { border-color: #ff8b7a; } .ds-btn-danger:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-danger:disabled { color: #7d765f; background: transparent; border: 1px dashed #3a3324; cursor: default; }

components.name: Interactive Row
components.description: Tappable list item with chevron affordance — job, adventurer, zone, settings.
components.css: .ds-row-interactive { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 9px 11px; border: 1px solid #3a3324; border-radius: 10px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #2b2519, #201c15); color: #ece7db; text-align: left; font: inherit; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.12s, border-color 0.12s, transform 0.06s; } .ds-row-interactive::after { content: ''; width: 7px; height: 7px; flex-shrink: 0; border-right: 1.5px solid #7d765f; border-bottom: 1.5px solid #7d765f; transform: rotate(-45deg); margin-left: -2px; } .ds-row-interactive:hover { border-color: #a98f3a; } .ds-row-interactive:active { transform: scale(0.995); } .ds-row-info { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; min-width: 0; } .ds-row-name { font-weight: 600; } .ds-row-sub { color: #a1997f; font-size: 0.85rem; } .ds-row-cost { font-weight: 600; color: #ffd75e; white-space: nowrap; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-end; gap: 2px; }

components.name: Static Row (NoteRow)
components.description: Read-only informational row with full-contrast text, no interaction affordance.
components.html: Total Battles247 wins · 3 losses
components.css: .ds-row-static { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 9px 11px; background: transparent; color: #ece7db; border: 1px solid #3a3324; border-radius: 10px; } .ds-row-icon { color: #a1997f; align-self: flex-start; margin-top: 0.15em; display: inline-flex; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-row-info { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; min-width: 0; flex: 1; } .ds-row-name { font-weight: 600; } .ds-row-sub { color: #a1997f; font-size: 0.85rem; }

components.name: Modal Dialog
components.description: Three-part modal: fixed header, scrollable body, pinned footer. On mobile docks as bottom sheet.
components.html:
Equip Weapon

Choose a weapon for your adventurer.
components.css: .ds-modal { width: 100%; max-width: 440px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; background: #201c15; border: 1px solid #a98f3a; border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.6); } .ds-modal-header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 10px 18px; border-bottom: 1px solid #3a3324; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-modal-title { margin: 0; font-family: 'Cinzel', 'Playfair Display', serif; font-size: 1.2rem; font-weight: 700; color: #ffd75e; } .ds-modal-close { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; flex-shrink: 0; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: #a1997f; cursor: pointer; } .ds-modal-close:hover { background: #2b2519; color: #ece7db; } .ds-modal-body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; padding: 14px; overflow-y: auto; overscroll-behavior: contain; } .ds-modal-footer { display: flex; gap: 6px; padding: 10px 14px calc(10px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); border-top: 1px solid #3a3324; background: #201c15; }

components.name: Tab Bar Navigation
components.description: Fixed bottom navigation — five tabs (Overview, Town, Guild, Map, Items) with icon + label stack.
components.css: .ds-tab { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 3px; min-height: 44px; padding: 5px 2px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; background: none; color: #a1997f; cursor: pointer; font: inherit; transition: background 0.1s, color 0.1s; } .ds-tab:hover { color: #ece7db; } .ds-tab-active { background: #2b2519; color: #ffd75e; } .ds-tab-icon { font-size: 1.2rem; line-height: 1; } .ds-tab-label { font-size: 0.66rem; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Stat Tile
components.description: Labelled value tile used in stat grids — fits auto-fill columns, one per metric.
components.html: 1,247Battles Won
components.css: .ds-stat { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 1px; padding: 8px 4px; border: 1px solid #3a3324; border-radius: 8px; background: #201c15; } .ds-stat-value { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: #ece7db; } .ds-stat-label { font-size: 0.66rem; font-weight: 600; color: #a1997f; text-align: center; line-height: 1.25; }

components.name: Progress Bar
components.description: Thin progress track with colored fill — XP (emerald), HP (red gradient), or generic (gold).
components.css: .ds-progress-track { flex: 1; height: 6px; border-radius: 3px; background: #14120e; border: 1px solid #3a3324; overflow: hidden; } .ds-progress-fill { display: block; height: 100%; transition: width 0.2s linear; } .ds-progress-fill.xp { background: #8fdc6f; } .ds-progress-fill.hp { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #d0473b, #ff8b7a); } .ds-progress-time { font-size: 0.66rem; color: #a1997f; white-space: nowrap; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Toggle Switch
components.description: Binary toggle with pill track and circular knob — off (dark) and on (gold).
components.css: .ds-toggle { width: 44px; height: 26px; border-radius: 13px; border: 1px solid #3a3324; background: #14120e; cursor: pointer; padding: 2px; display: flex; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-toggle[aria-checked="true"] { background: #a98f3a; justify-content: flex-end; } .ds-toggle-knob { width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 50%; background: #ece7db; }

narrative.overview:
The interface is a guild hall at dusk: deep wood-panelled walls, warm candlelight, the gleam of gold on dark surfaces. Every screen sits in this room — the fire is always within sight, even when the player is deep in a menu or studying an item's stats. The warmth comes from the palette (cream text on brown-black grounds, gold as the voice of action and progress) and from the craft: borders are burnished brass, interactive elements lift with purpose, and every rarity tier has its own distinct gem-like glow.

The game's RPG systems (adventurers, equipment, stats) demand scanability and density, so the visual system stays disciplined under the fantasy surface. Typography carries the gravitas — Cinzel for the guild's voice, Source Sans 3 for the ledgers — while spacing, radius, and tonal layering keep information legible on a phone-sized screen.
keyCharacteristics: Warm dark: not blue-black or neutral grey, but warm brown-black — the dark of a fire-lit interior.
Gold as action: the accent isn't decorative; it marks wealth, progress, interactive intent, and the player's agency.
Tonal depth: surfaces stack by luminance, not by shadow. The deeper the surface, the darker the tone.
Ceremonious components: buttons have linear gradients, distinct borders, and press feedback — every action feels weighty.
Purposeful motion: every animation serves feedback (press, progress, notification), ceremony (ascension, story beats), or spatial orientation (sheet rise, dropdown). No decorative loops.
Jewel-box rarities: five rarity tiers with distinct hues (blue → purple → orange → magenta) each with tinted surfaces and soft glows.
Reduced motion as a system property: animations degrade gracefully — .reduced-motion class and prefers-reduced-motion media query are first-class constraints.

rules.name: The Hearth Rule
rules.body: Gold (Guild Gold) is always the warmest element on screen. No other color competes with it for the role of 'what demands attention.' When a rarity color or Frost Crystal appears, gold recedes to its structural role.

rules.name: The Rarity Gradient Rule
rules.body: Rarity tiers follow a fixed hue arc (blue → purple → orange → magenta) that never varies. Every equipment item, border, and label uses its tier's exact hue — no interpolation, no custom tints.

rules.name: The One Cinzel Per View Rule
rules.body: No more than one Cinzel element per distinct visual region — the gold amount in the header, a story title in a modal, a headline on a panel. Two Cinzel elements in the same viewport compete for the ceremonial voice and both lose.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces at rest have no shadow. A shadow must be earned by being a floating element (modal, dropdown, toast, fixed bar) or a rarity glow. If it sits in the scroll flow, it's tonal, not lifted.

rules.name: The Decoration Rule
rules.body: If an animation cannot be named by what it communicates (press feedback, state change, ceremony, spatial orientation), it does not belong. Decorative looping animations — idle spinners, rotating icons, background parallax — are not part of the system.

rules.name: The Reduced Motion Invariant
rules.body: Every animated element has a non-animated end state that carries the same information. The reduced-motion path is not a degraded experience; it is the same experience without motion.

rules.name: The Heraldic Geometry Rule
rules.body: The charter layer uses opposed notched corners (3px 11px 3px 11px, scaling to 4px 18px 4px 18px for ceremonial controls). Apply to the shell's important controls, chapter panels, floating notices, and modals — not to every dense data tile. Circles are reserved for coins, wax-seal notices, and impact rings.

rules.name: The Charter Responsive Rule
rules.body: At desktop widths the 520px operating column is visibly mounted inside the darker timber field with fine brass side rules. At phone widths the outer frame disappears and the charter becomes full-bleed; touch targets, information density, and the fixed navigation contract do not change.

dos: Do use Guild Gold as the single point of action on any screen. When everything is gold, nothing is.
Do use tonal layering (darker → lighter surfaces) for depth instead of shadows. Shadows are for floating elements only.
Do keep rarity colors locked to their hue positions in the arc (blue → purple → orange → magenta). No interpolation between tiers.
Do use dashed borders as the universal 'unavailable' signal — works for locked rows, disabled buttons, empty slots.
Do let Cinzel breathe — one display-face element per viewport, not competing voices.
Do make every tappable element at least 44px in one dimension. The game is thumb-operated on phones.
Do use ease-out for authored motion. Elements should arrive at their destination and stop — no bounce, no overshoot unless the moment is specifically ceremonial.
Do animate press feedback with a transform snap (≤60ms), not a longer transition. Input acknowledgment must feel simultaneous with the finger.
Do use reduced-motion variants for every animated element: prefer opacity transitions over keyframe-driven animations when the user opts out.
Do give every ceremonial animation a static end state that carries the same information — the reduced-motion path is not a degraded experience.
donts: Don't put body text in white (#fff). Use Parchment Cream (#ece7db) — it reads as warm light, not a cold screen.
Don't use opacity to dim text. Use the dedicated neutral text tokens (Warm Ember, Shadow Ash). Opacity compounds unpredictably against varied backgrounds.
Don't split rarity tinting rules — every equipment picker, grid item, detail panel, and equipped-slot label uses the same tier → hue mapping.
Don't invent additional elevation layers. The system has three surface tones and three shadow levels. A fourth tone without a role weakens the hierarchy.
Don't use solid borders on disabled controls. Dashed is the established contract.
Don't add a subscription, pricing, or any commerce surface — the game is free, single-player, no monetization.
Don't add decorative looping animations — idle spinners, rotating icons, background parallax, or any motion that cannot be named by what it communicates.
Don't animate tab switches or panel transitions. Navigation is instant — delaying it reads as lag, not polish.
Don't animate elements that appear and disappear in the normal flow (tooltips, pickers, dropdowns). Use the fast tier only for the state change that triggered them.
